title: Discover Halifax: Private City Tour with a Local Guide
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Make the most of your time in Halifax with a private sightseeing experience created just for your group. Your local driver-guide will pick you up anywhere in downtown Halifax and accompany you throughout the tour, taking you to some of the city's most memorable landmarks.

Discover Halifax's historic sights, visit the Titanic memorial at Fairview Lawn Cemetery, explore the beautiful Halifax Public Gardens, learn about the Halifax Explosion Memorial, and see the iconic Halifax Citadel.

Along the way, your driver-guide will share local knowledge, answer your questions, and give you a personal introduction to the city. With private transportation and no strangers in your group, you can enjoy Halifax comfortably and at your own pace.

Whether you're visiting for the first time, traveling with family or friends, or simply have a few hours to explore, this relaxed private tour is an easy and enjoyable way to experience the highlights of Halifax with a local by your side.
